[LSIG.5.4] The state of the three signal aggregations is not evicted after a
window of silence, in any mode ([LSER.9.3.1]). A boolean slot idle between
bursts holds its last value through the gap. A stuck `true` reads as `true`:
`active_fraction` reads `1.0` once its open interval spans the window, and a
`true` asserted after a held `true` is no rising edge. `t_first` does not reset
([LSER.19.7]), so `onset_rate`'s warm-up correction applies over the instance's
first `W` only. Silence is not an observation that the signal changed: an author
who needs a dead sensor to read differently from a steady one should pair these
aggregations with an explicit liveness check ([LSIG.6.1]).
